constraints.title: Positive waist shaping
constraints.detail: The back takeout is (H + Eh − W − Ew − 1) / 4. Its positivity also satisfies the front takeout condition. This is one shared constraint, not four automatic adjustments.
constraints.range_effect: At fixed W and H, +1 cm hip ease raises the intake-only upper bound of waist ease by 1 cm. +1 cm waist lowers it by 1 cm. Conversely, Eh > W + Ew − H + 1. Other limits can be tighter.

constraints.title: Body proportion guard
constraints.detail: The current engine rejects waist circumference equal to or greater than hip circumference. This is an implementation restriction, not a statement about which human bodies are valid.
constraints.range_effect: Measured body values remain unchanged; this guard determines whether the current drafting setup supports them.

constraints.title: Length and hip depth
constraints.detail: The hem must be below the hip level. Hip depth is fixed at 18 cm in this experiment.
constraints.range_effect: Raising fixed hip depth raises the strict geometric lower bound on length. A bound endpoint cannot be offered as a valid normalized endpoint.

constraints.title: One allocation budget
constraints.equation: sBS + sBP + sFS + sFP = 1; every share ≥ 0
constraints.detail: The four shares allocate a single total. Increasing one requires reducing the others; a share is not independently adjustable while all three others stay fixed.
constraints.range_effect: With three shares fixed, the fourth is fixed at their remainder. Use an allocation policy or a lower-dimensional parameterization before normalizing.

constraints.title: Side-edge additions and slope
constraints.equation: aSide = F × sSide / 2; slope = aSide / (L − 0.5 − D)
constraints.detail: The slope is the hip-to-raised-hem endpoint chord, not the entire curved side seam. It describes flare when the hem endpoint is below the hip. The current 0.5 cm side-hem rise is held fixed.
constraints.range_effect: If a style-specific maximum slope is later chosen, it will jointly constrain F, each side share, L and D. No slope limit has been approved.

constraints.title: Princess-edge additions and slope
constraints.equation: aPrincess = F × sPrincess / 4; slope = aPrincess / (L − D)
constraints.detail: Each princess allocation is split over its two edges in the half garment. Equal F at different lengths does not give equal flare slope. At F = 0, every distribution yields zero added flare.
constraints.range_effect: A future edge-flare boundary constrains fullness and its corresponding share together. A zero share produces no bound from that edge addition alone.

constraints.title: Side shape as a design boundary
constraints.detail: Waist/hip targets and side hem additions jointly shape the side. Define waist→hip, hip→hem and whole-side straightness separately; a straight inclined seam is not a vertical seam.
constraints.range_effect: Measure conditional boundaries before deciding whether more fullness allows more or less waist ease. Do not infer a universal direction from one silhouette.

constraints.title: Upper fit geometry and side balance
constraints.equation: F: 32 → 64 cm; maximum upper-knot shift ≈ 0.539 cm
constraints.detail: The fixed-body study measures an indirect upper-geometry response to fullness. Side length balance drives front dart transfer. Bust and back length set upper geometry; their conditional boundary effects have not been measured in this study.
constraints.range_effect: The fullness observation establishes coupling, not a derivative, monotonic effect or range for bust/back length. Test joint settings and the 0.08 cm transfer-activation branch.

constraints.title: Cut-outline compatibility
constraints.equation: Acceptable cut region: to be mapped
constraints.detail: Seam allowance offsets the generated contours. Geometry-changing controls may alter concavities and offset validity. The current 15 cases pass at SA = 1 cm; that does not prove every joint setting.
constraints.range_effect: Any supported normalized range must retain allowance and other construction settings in its context and record outline failures.

constraints.title: Measured fullness response
constraints.detail: This is the maximum displacement of corresponding above-waist seam knots in the fixed-body study. It is a derived observation, not an independently controlled input.
constraints.range_effect: This result motivates a coupled boundary study. It does not establish a safe maximum F or a derivative.
